C0_T1_C1_1.name: Parithya
C0_T1_C1_1.text: I thought we talked about not sharing?

C0_T1_C1_3.name: Parithya
C0_T1_C1_3.text: That doesn’t mean you can sit wherever you want.

C0_T1_C1_4.name: Parithya
C0_T1_C1_4.text: This booth is spoken for. And you don’t have my permission.

C0_T1_C1_5.name: Kaz
C0_T1_C1_5.text: I’m sorry you’re having the worst day right now, but there are more important things than a seat.

C0_T1_C1_7.name: Kaz
C0_T1_C1_7.text: We’ve got a job offer. For a healing potion that heals instantly. I saw the demo myself.

C0_T1_C1_9.name: Erenis
C0_T1_C1_9.text: It’s a small job. Just a couple of ancient books.

C0_T1_C1_10.name: Parithya
C0_T1_C1_10.text: From the most impenetrable library in the entire country?

C0_T1_C1_13.name: Erenis
C0_T1_C1_13.text: Sleep. Healing isn’t the only thing I do.

C0_T1_C1_14.name: Parithya
C0_T1_C1_14.text: Fine. I’m sure Kaz has read you the rules.

C0_T1_C1_15.name: Erenis
C0_T1_C1_15.text: And I understand every one of them.

C0_T1_C1_16.name: Kaz
C0_T1_C1_16.text: But we must act right now. We’ve no time to waste.

C0_T1_C1_17.name: Erenis
C0_T1_C1_17.text: It is as he says. The spell isn’t as potent if I’m not there.

C1_T1_C1_2.name: Kaz
C1_T1_C1_2.text: It’s the middle of the day.

C1_T1_C1_3.name: Parithya
C1_T1_C1_3.text: I just thought that halfling had more power.

C1_T1_C1_4.name: Kaz
C1_T1_C1_4.text: There should be a side entrance for employees.

C1_T1_C1_5.name: Parithya
C1_T1_C1_5.text: If everyone’s really asleep inside, then there’s no use being discreet.

C2_T1_C1_1.name: Parithya
C2_T1_C1_1.text: So far, your source checks out.

C2_T1_C1_3.name: Parithya
C2_T1_C1_3.text: Let’s hurry up and finish this.

C2_T1_C1_4.name: Kaz
C2_T1_C1_4.text: So you could get back to drinking or kissing people you don’t care about?

C2_T1_C1_5.name: Parithya
C2_T1_C1_5.text: Let’s not fight right now, Kaz. The clock is ticking.

C3_T1_C1_1.name: Parithya
C3_T1_C1_1.text: I think the book might be in the basement. Under the floorboards. In a tunnel that leads to a ditch far east.

C3_T1_C1_2.name: Kaz
C3_T1_C1_2.text: It needs a key or a spell. But if I cast, the sleep will disperse.
options: Keys are boring, but they’ll do.

C3_T1_C2_1.name: Kaz
C3_T1_C2_1.text: It never hurts to be safe. Or out of jail.

C3_T1_C2_2.name: Parithya
C3_T1_C2_2.text: Don’t worry, you’ll see the inside of a cell soon enough. People who hang around me often do.

C4_T1_C1_1.name: Parithya
C4_T1_C1_1.text: These are more recent than I expected.

C4_T1_C1_2.name: Kaz
C4_T1_C1_2.text: It’s just research on slime ooze properties. You can pack them with Raitma and chamomile to make better healing potions.

C4_T1_C1_4.name: Kaz
C4_T1_C1_4.text: Not really. Subtle chemical reactions, I suppose. But this could help.

C4_T1_C1_5.name: Parithya
C4_T1_C1_5.text: You don’t want to give them in?

C4_T1_C1_6.name: Kaz
C4_T1_C1_6.text: They won’t need all the books.

C5_T1_C1_3.name: Kaz
C5_T1_C1_3.text: Whatever’s there is what was there.

C5_T1_C1_8.name: Erenis
C5_T1_C1_8.text: It was good doing business with you.

C5_T1_C1_10.name: Erenis
C5_T1_C1_10.text: I’m leaving. Sorry to hog your booth.

C6_T1_C1_1.name: Parithya
C6_T1_C1_1.text: You don’t have to stay, you know. I like being alone.

C6_T1_C1_3.name: Parithya
C6_T1_C1_3.text: Just don’t bother me. And don’t sign us up for more jobs without a private conversation.

C6_T1_C1_4.name: Kaz
C6_T1_C1_4.text: Apologies. The prize was too good to pass up.

C6_T1_C1_5.name: Parithya
C6_T1_C1_5.text: Then we should get some sleep. We’ll head out in the morning and get this where it belongs.

start.name: Parithya
start.text: Why is the tavern open this early?

start_1.name: Parithya
start_1.text: Unless Mirna knew I'd be coming.

Tavern_start.name: Parithya
Tavern_start.text: I think I'll take something a little harder today.

Tavern_start_1.name: Mirna
Tavern_start_1.text: Alright, but you might want to check your booth first.

Tavern_start_2.name: Parithya
Tavern_start_2.text: You let someone sit in my booth?

Tavern_OL.name: Mirna
Tavern_OL.text: I'll get started on that drink.

Erenis_OL.name: Erenis
Erenis_OL.text: Don't dally, or they'll wake up.

Key_UF_C1_1.name: Parithya
Key_UF_C1_1.text: What kind of idiot leaves a key on the floor?
